# apiname_domain_nameservers (Resource)

Manages the nameservers for a DomainNameAPI domain registration. This resource updates the nameservers on an existing domain — it does not register or delete domains.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apiname_domain_nameservers" "example" {
  domain_name = "example.com"

  nameservers = [
    "ns1.yourdns.com",
    "ns2.yourdns.com",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) The domain name to manage, e.g. "abt.me".
- `nameservers` (Set of String) Set of nameservers to assign to the domain. Order does not matter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The domain name (used as the resource identifier).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apiname_domain_nameservers.example abt.me
```
